name: Most Wanted
source:
The heat is on when a no-nonsense Texas Marshal and a Hollywood detective are thrown together to stop a deranged hitman. Can you catch the killer?

[From [url=http://choices-stories-you-play.wikia.com/wiki/Most_Wanted,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
一名不苟言笑的德州元帅与好莱坞侦探被迫合作，阻止疯狂杀手。你能抓住凶手吗？

[来源：[url=http://choices-stories-you-play.wikia.com/wiki/Most_Wanted,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
